assessment: Product QA and recommendation, not implementation

defects.title: Detailed errors disappear at the native bridge
defects.repro: Call transaction.apply with a stale revision or wrong document; submit an invalid batch; export an unsupported SwiftUI layout.
defects.actual: Each returns “A JavaScript exception occurred”. The invalid edits are correctly rejected, but the client cannot distinguish why.
defects.expected: Stable error code, readable cause, current document/revision and recoverable action; preserve unsupported-feature details.
defects.impact: Agents cannot repair requests reliably; humans cannot diagnose export limitations.

resolution.summary: HTTP and stdio retain error codes, cause, document/revision and recovery guidance.

defects.title: An invalid export target silently returns HTML
defects.repro: Call code.export with target:"png", which is outside the advertised enum.
defects.actual: Successful HTML response instead of validation failure.
defects.expected: Reject invalid tool inputs before dispatch; export target and response MIME must agree.
defects.impact: A successful protocol response can produce the wrong artifact.

resolution.summary: Invalid export targets and invalid batches reject before mutation.

defects.title: A color token overrides the selected variant’s fill
defects.repro: Create a button master with fillToken=color.brand; add a Danger variant with literal red fill; select Danger on an instance.
defects.actual: Scene fill becomes red but the token still wins in rendering/export; the button stays purple.
defects.expected: Define token/variant precedence and support variant token bindings; inspector, scene and exports agree.
defects.impact: Critical and primary actions can be visually indistinguishable.

resolution.summary: Literal variant fills shadow inherited tokens; bindings, overrides and reset are retained.

defects.title: Cross-document paste silently loses component identity
defects.repro: Native Developer → Copy element on a linked card instance; create a document and Cmd+V.
defects.actual: Five editable nodes arrive, but zero component links and zero masters; the referenced master is absent from the payload.
defects.expected: Carry component dependency closure or explicitly offer detach/resolve; preserve overrides and portable fallback.
defects.impact: Reusing a UI kit across files turns a maintained component into unrelated shapes.

resolution.summary: Recursive master dependencies, token collisions, variants and local overrides survive cross-document paste.

defects.title: Cross-page navigation works but its inspector says No action
defects.repro: MCP-link the sign-in button to the success artboard on another page; select it in native Prototype mode.
defects.actual: Preview navigates correctly. The picker offers only the current-page artboard and displays No action for the valid cross-page target.
defects.expected: List all eligible document artboards with page context and reflect the existing link accurately.
defects.impact: A designer cannot inspect or author a supported flow through the UI.

resolution.summary: The picker lists document artboards with page context and reflects existing links.

defects.title: Web handoff collapses intentional text line breaks
defects.repro: Export the mobile headline “A little clarity.\nA lot of progress.”; render actual HTML and compiled Tailwind in Chrome.
defects.actual: The newline remains in text data but CSS white-space is normal; the editor uses pre-wrap. Angular shares the same style generation.
defects.expected: Preserve authored white-space semantics across supported targets and validate a multiline fixture.
defects.impact: Generated screens compile while visibly changing the design.

resolution.summary: HTML, Angular and Tailwind retain authored whitespace.

defects.title: SwiftUI controls do not retain authored typography and padding
defects.repro: Compile the actual mobile SwiftUI export and render it in an NSHostingView; inspect button/input modifiers and stack generation.
defects.actual: Compilation passes. Buttons/inputs lack authored font modifiers; stack padding is not emitted. Text weight mapping reduces many weights to regular/semibold.
defects.expected: A documented supported subset preserves layout, control fonts and padding, with explicit diagnostics for unsupported constructs.
defects.impact: “Idiomatic SwiftUI” is not yet dependable visual handoff.
defects.confidence: Compiled native fixture + source; appearance environment is a limitation

resolution.summary: Control font sizes/weights and stack/control padding are emitted; a real consumer typechecks.

defects.title: Corrupt image bytes are accepted without an asset diagnostic
defects.repro: Add image source data:image/png;base64,aGVsbG8= (base64 of hello, not PNG pixels).
defects.actual: Batch commits, capture succeeds, editor displays a broken image without a specific asset failure.
defects.expected: Decode and validate assets, or surface a node-level loading/failure state with a repair action.
defects.impact: Saved documents can look incomplete while reporting a healthy state.

resolution.summary: Decode failures identify nodes. Replace image validates pixels and preserves the layer; undo restores the original.

defects.title: Stored dissolve transitions are not implemented by preview
defects.repro: Set a prototype link transition to dissolve and follow the link.
defects.actual: Preview changes screens directly. Runtime activation does not consume transition; the inspector has no transition control.
defects.expected: Implement the advertised transition or reject/report it as unavailable; match UI and schema.
defects.impact: A stored design property promises behavior the prototype does not provide.
defects.confidence: Source + native navigation; no frame timing measurement

resolution.summary: Actual crossfade, transition selection, Back, reduced motion and unchanged authored revision.

defects.title: The checked-in browser acceptance command is red
defects.repro: Run bun run test:e2e and the remaining individual browser jobs.
defects.actual: editor-e2e and components-e2e time out on the obsolete exact label Text. Ten other jobs pass. Copies changing only that locator to Text content pass.
defects.expected: Update maintained locators and require the original complete command to pass in CI.
defects.impact: The project cannot presently claim a green end-to-end gate.

resolution.summary: The full original runner passes with canvas regressions; CI runs the same 15 suites and typecheck.

roadmap.outcome: Make document and transport truth reliable
roadmap.scope: QA-01/02; typed native bridge errors; schema validation for every tool; reject unsupported properties/targets consistently; expose committed/rendered/durable status and document context.
roadmap.acceptance: HTTP and stdio distinguish stale_revision, wrong_document, invalid_input, unsupported_feature, loading and timeout. Atomicity/retry tests stay green. A successful image has its exact revision and render status. Failed saves never report durable success.

roadmap.outcome: Make component reuse and style precedence trustworthy
roadmap.scope: QA-03/04; dependency-complete editable clipboard; explicit detach choice; variant token precedence and token bindings.
roadmap.acceptance: Cross-document Button/Card paste retains master identity, nested instances, variant and local overrides; absent libraries retain a fallback. Token change, variant switch, undo/redo and each export produce the same effective style.

roadmap.outcome: Establish export fidelity as a release gate
roadmap.scope: QA-06/07; supported-feature matrix; HTML/Angular/Tailwind white-space; SwiftUI layout/fonts/padding; semantic controls; precise unsupported diagnostics.
roadmap.acceptance: Real isolated consumers compile with no Maple dependency. Multiline/localized text, stack padding, all supported weights, forms and mixed SVG fixtures have documented geometry/visual tolerances. Unsupported content fails clearly or exports with an explicit diagnostic.

roadmap.outcome: Restore reproducible QA and native workflow evidence
roadmap.scope: QA-05/09/10; cross-page route inspection and accurate transition support; actual saved-file open/close/reopen/crash recovery; browser/native test matrix; release packaging; investigate color wells and generic file-open alert.
roadmap.acceptance: Original install/typecheck/build/unit/e2e/MCP commands pass. Native picker can select a .syrup package as a document. Reopen validates scene/history/assets; force-kill recovery is tested in an isolated fixture. Reference hardware and skipped checks are recorded.

roadmap.outcome: Design real layouts without manual coordinate workarounds
roadmap.scope: Font family, line height, tracking, text alignment/styles; axis/individual padding; alignment/distribution, wrapping, min/max, breakpoint rules and child constraints.
roadmap.acceptance: A dashboard, sign-in and multilingual settings form resize at 320/393/768/1200 px in browser/WKWebView and exported consumers. Documented clipping/overflow rules hold; font assets work offline; each user/MCP gesture is one undo step.

roadmap.outcome: Prototype everyday tasks with useful semantics
roadmap.scope: QA-05/09; cross-page routes; secure/typed inputs, labels, disabled/focus/loading/error states; overlays, scrolling, transitions and basic state retention.
roadmap.acceptance: Sign-in → validation → success plus modal open/close and scrolling can be authored from UI and MCP. Preview does not dirty the design, password input is masked, keyboard operation works, Back has defined state behavior.

roadmap.outcome: Create a usable asset and repeated-data workflow
roadmap.scope: QA-08; validated local asset catalog, crop/fit/fill, failure states; map named text/image fields in Repeat Grid and import local CSV/JSON.
roadmap.acceptance: Repeated project cards populate title/status/avatar independently, preserve instance overrides and export portable asset references. Corrupt/missing images identify their node. Reopen and offline export preserve pixels and provenance.

roadmap.outcome: Connect one production component library end to end
roadmap.scope: A pinned local manifest for one Angular library and one SwiftUI mapping; typed props/slots, token bindings, real examples, dependency declarations and editable fallbacks. Start with Button, Input and Card.
roadmap.acceptance: Insert → edit → variant/state → copy code → compile consuming fixture → reopen offline works for all three components. Version update shows a change review and can be reversed. Unknown library retains visible fallback and diagnoses lost linkage.

roadmap.outcome: Make agents efficient on production-sized documents
roadmap.scope: Scoped tree/node reads, component/token discovery, document targeting, cropped captures, incremental invalidation and measured viewport virtualization.
roadmap.acceptance: At 1k and 5k nodes, collect command/paint/frame/MCP latency separately on defined hardware. Rendering preserves offscreen layout while avoiding unnecessary mounted nodes. Race/revision tests pass; clients do not need full-document reads for one property edit.

roadmap.outcome: Prove real code previews before adding an embedded code IDE
roadmap.scope: Isolated web component runtime with typed contract; trusted separate native Swift preview helper. Opt-in local source editing only after library adoption is proven.
roadmap.acceptance: Versioned components render the real implementation with offline fixtures and typed events, cannot access the privileged host bridge, and keep portable fallback/graph semantics. Diagnostics link to source. Native builds are cancellable and stale results cannot replace a newer revision.

implementationFollowUp.scope: QA-01 through QA-10 and integrated Whiteboard canvas
